observed_changes: DSR option hooks emit selected RREQ, RREP, and RERR events.
Route-cache hooks emit selected lookup, add, update, invalidation, and expiry events.
Routing hooks emit selected discovery, route-failure, maintenance, recovery, and transmission events.
The scratch driver can write an event JSONL stream and DLT_RAW IPv4 PCAP plus packet index.
The patch adds a DsrRouting::Start() early return when m_priorityQueue is already populated; this is a lifecycle behavior change and requires focused regression coverage.
known_review_items: Manual JSON escaping still requires testing of arbitrary control characters in future dynamic string fields.
Logging overhead and event-hook coverage have not been measured across the scenario matrix.
The external results tree was intentionally excluded and is not validated pilot evidence.
